comments.author: Priya Sarkar
comments.comment: The missing area is eval-driven rollback. Most agent incidents come from context drift, not model weakness, so snapshot prompts, tool outputs, and retrieved docs per run. Which metric catches drift earliest in your stack? #AgenticAI #Evals #LLM

comments.author: Ori Goshen
comments.comment: I ship agentic workflows, and the harness is where ownership pays. If evals, memory, and tool routing are model-agnostic, swapping weights becomes a pricing decision, not a rewrite. How are you measuring the switching cost in production? #AIEvals

comments.author: Deccan AI
comments.comment:
Most enterprise data is useless to a lab until it is consented, de-identified, licensed, and mapped to evals; the real cost is expert time, not compute.

What is your team doing to prove that private data actually improves downstream evals, not just training loss?

#EnterpriseAI
